result.brief: 提出 Time-JEPA，用时间对齐的低维物理时间序列作为辅助监督微调视频世界模型，使视频表征保留物理状态演化信息，提升当前状态解码、多步未来状态预测与运动学重建。
result.reason: Fine-tunes video world models with temporally aligned physical time series as auxiliary supervision, improving video representation grounding across driving, manipulation, and motion domains.
